meta.name: etsy-shop-catalog
meta.description: Etsy shop catalog scraper: given an Etsy shop URL (e.g. https://www.etsy.com/shop/{shop-name}) and optional page number, returns paginated product listings from that shop's own storefront with listingId, shopId, title, url, image, salePrice, originalPrice, currency, rating, reviewCount, shopName, isAd, freeShipping, badge. Use when user mentions Etsy shop, Etsy seller, Etsy store, etsy.com/shop, scrape Etsy shop, extract all products from Etsy shop, Etsy shop catalog, Etsy seller catalog, list all Etsy shop items, Etsy storefront scraper, Etsy vendor products, Etsy competitor shop, Etsy shop monitoring, get inventory of an Etsy shop, dump Etsy shop products, Etsy seller product export, seller product benchmarking, Etsy shop bulk export. Also applies to competitor shop tracking, supplier catalog collection, price monitoring for a specific shop, new-item detection on a shop, and any paginated bulk collection driven by a single Etsy shop URL.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 抓取 Etsy 店铺全部商品信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量获取 Etsy 店铺的商品目录用于分析或监控。
copy.tagline_en: Scrape all product listings from an Etsy shop
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to bulk extract product catalogs from Etsy shops for analysis or monitoring.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你给的 Etsy 店铺网址，自动抓取该店铺的商品列表，包括商品 ID、标题、价格、评分等信息，并支持翻页获取全部商品。
howto.when: 当你提到 Etsy 店铺、卖家、商品目录，或要求抓取、导出某 Etsy 店铺的全部商品时触发。

say.text: 列出 Etsy 店铺 ExampleShop 的商品目录，包括价格和评分。
say.note: Claude 会抓取并展示商品列表。

say.text: 导出 Etsy 店铺 ExampleShop 的全部商品信息。
say.note: Claude 会翻页抓取所有商品并汇总。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can scrape product listings from a given Etsy shop URL, including listing ID, title, price, rating, etc., and supports pagination to get all products.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention an Etsy shop, seller, catalog, or ask to scrape/export all products from an Etsy shop.

say_en.text: Scrape all products from this Etsy shop: https://www.etsy.com/shop/ExampleShop
say_en.note: Claude will start scraping the first page and return results.

say_en.text: List the catalog of Etsy shop ExampleShop with prices and ratings.
say_en.note: Claude will scrape and display the product list.

say_en.text: Export all product info from Etsy shop ExampleShop.
say_en.note: Claude will paginate and collect all products.
